question: Should MarkdownLinkSpan’s public Plugin SDK contract gain the optional autoLinked parser-provenance field for channel renderers?
rationale: The field is a clean generic solution to the ambiguity, but it becomes a supported external plugin type property and therefore needs explicit ownership rather than being accepted as an incidental Telegram implementation detail.

options.title: Approve generic provenance
options.body: Accept the optional field as a supported text-chunking contract, retain its propagation tests, and merge after live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep provenance private
options.body: Request a narrower internal parsing or rendering seam so external plugins do not observe a new MarkdownLinkSpan property.

recommendation.title: Approve generic provenance
recommendation.body: Accept the optional field as a supported text-chunking contract, retain its propagation tests, and merge after live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and co-authored the original Telegram file-reference behavior and is the strongest available owner for accepting its shared SDK refinement.
